title: Autellix: An Efficient Serving Engine for LLM Agents as General Programs
authors: Michael Luo; Xiaoxiang Shi; Colin Cai; Tianjun Zhang; Justin Wong; Yichuan Wang; Chi Wang; Yanping Huang; Zhifeng Chen; Joseph E. Gonzalez; Ion Stoica
affiliations: UC Berkeley, Google DeepMind, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Datacenter networking, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems treat LLM calls as independent requests, ignoring program-level dependencies and context, which leads to head-of-line blocking and suboptimal end-to-end latency for agentic programs. This results in significant waiting times for programs as they scale their inference computation.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統將每次 LLM 呼叫視為獨立請求，忽略程式層級的依賴關係與上下文，導致 agentic 程式出現隊頭阻塞（head-of-line blocking）與次優的端到端延遲；隨著 inference 計算規模擴大，程式等待時間也隨之顯著增加。

key_innovation.en: Autellix introduces a stateful serving engine that treats agentic programs as first-class citizens, utilizing program-level statistics (cumulative service time) to inform scheduling and load balancing. It proposes two non-clairvoyant scheduling algorithms, PLAS (for single-threaded) and ATLAS (for multi-threaded DAGs), to prioritize calls based on program progress.
key_innovation.zh: Autellix 引入一套有狀態的 serving 引擎，將 agentic 程式作為一等公民，利用程式層級統計資訊（累計服務時間）指導 scheduling 與負載均衡。其提出兩種非預知型 scheduling 演算法：PLAS（針對單執行緒）與 ATLAS（針對多執行緒 DAG），依據程式進度對呼叫進行優先排序。

key_improvements.en: 4-15x throughput increase at the same latency compared to vLLM; up to 1.5x throughput improvement over standard load-balancers across engines.
key_improvements.zh: 在相同延遲條件下，吞吐量相較於 vLLM 提升 4–15x；跨引擎場景中相較於標準負載均衡器吞吐量最高提升 1.5x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Agentic Programs, Multi-agent Systems, ReAct, MCTS, Chatbot
